name: repr-context-bioclimraw
cmd: set -e; for c in gp_species_base desk_tempho_1995; do export ESK_DESK_CONFIG=config/overlays/$c.json; {python} research/exp/nbr_covariates.py --cache {cache}/$c --out {out}/$c/nbr; {python} research/exp/bioclim.py --cache {cache}/$c --out {out}/$c/bioclim_raw --no-ema; {python} research/exp/repr_regime.py --cache {cache}/$c --out {out}/$c --nbr {out}/$c/nbr/F_nbr.npy --bioclim-dir {out}/$c/bioclim_raw --quadratic; done
summarize: for c in gp_species_base desk_tempho_1995; do {python} research/exp/repr_regime.py --summarize {out}/$c; done
note: E039e: covariate PCs with 5x5 neighbourhood context vs desk; E039f: bioclim without the output EMA (matched smoothing)
